QuestInfo.name: Phantom's Token for an Epic Hero.
QuestInfo.0: Gaston has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.1: Gaston has a gift for you.

0.0: Master, there are few who could track your movements with the naked eye. I'm thrilled you've regained your old abilities.
0.1: The clever find it best to prepare for the worst. With that in mind, I've gotten you something.

no.0: Might I ask you to reconsider? It is, of course, your decision... but this should be of help to you in the future.

yes.0: Please let me know if you need anything, at any time.
